summary: 74-year-old hiker lost in the Vasquez Peak Wilderness after detouring around snowfields; ended up ~30 miles from his parked vehicle; climbed to higher ground for cell signal and reached 911 at 3:56 p.m.; six-member Grand County SAR team reached him ~8:01 p.m. and guided him to a trailhead, all clear by 10 p.m.; transported back to his vehicle.
responding_agency: Grand County Search and Rescue, Grand County Sheriff's Office dispatch
